a switch/match/when with 8 cases and a default
complexity.text:
def seededSwitch(x, y):
    match x:
        case 1:
            y = 1
        case 2:
            y = 2
        case 3:
            y = 3
        case 4:
            y = 4
        case 5:
            y = 5
        case 6:
            y = 6
        case 7:
            y = 7
        case 8:
            y = 8
        case _:
            y = 0
    return y

def seededTernary(x, y):
    y = y + 1 if x > 0 else y
    y = y + 1 if x > 1 else y
    y = y + 1 if x > 2 else y
    y = y + 1 if x > 3 else y
    y = y + 1 if x > 4 else y
    y = y + 1 if x > 5 else y
    y = y + 1 if x > 6 else y
    y = y + 1 if x > 7 else y
    return y

complexity.desc: comprehension filters (4 comprehensions, each a for and an if)
complexity.text:
def seededSpecial(x, y):
    v0 = [v for v in range(x) if v > 0]
    v1 = [v for v in range(x) if v > 1]
    v2 = [v for v in range(x) if v > 2]
    v3 = [v for v in range(x) if v > 3]
    y = len(v0) + len(v1) + len(v2) + len(v3)
    return y
